environment.description: Same container image deployed on GKE Autopilot cluster (1.28+). Pod scheduled with GKE Warden admission controller enforcing Baseline PodSecurity standard. Node uses gVisor (runsc) as OCI runtime via RuntimeClass 'gvisor'. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-syscalls' applies a seccomp profile (type: Localhost, localhostProfile: 'profiles/pipeline-runner.json') that permits only: read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, clone, execve, wait4, kill, fcntl, getdents64, getcwd, chdir, newfstatat, lseek, getpid, socket, connect, sendto, recvfrom, bind, listen, accept, getsockname, getpeername, setsockopt, getsockopt, epoll_create1, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, futex, set_tid_address, set_robust_list, arch_prctl, exit_group, exit. The seccomp profile DENIES: fork (clone with CLONE_VM unset), vfork, ptrace, mount, umount2, pivot_root, chroot, setns, unshare, personality, init_module, finit_module, delete_module, kexec_load, open_by_handle_at, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev, kcmp, seccomp, memfd_create, userfaultfd. The gVisor sentry intercepts all syscalls and applies its own compatibility layer which independently blocks mount/umount/pivot_root/setns/unshare regardless of seccomp. Container runs as UID 65534 (nobody) with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, capabilities drop ALL.
